+TERMINAL_STATES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "verified_agreement",
+        "resolver_verified",
+        "safe_rejection",
+        "checker_disagreement",
+        "source_ambiguity",
+        "formally_excluded",
+        "provider_or_transport_failure",
+    }
+)
+HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+VERSION = re.compile(r"\.v(\d+)\.json$")
+PAPER_ID = re.compile(r"^9709_([msw])(\d{2})_qp_([1-6])(\d)$")
+
+
+class ConsolidationError(RuntimeError):
+    """A fail-closed frozen-authority validation error."""
+
+
+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def compact_canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(
+        value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
+    ).encode()
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ConsolidationError(f"unreadable JSON authority: {path}: {exc}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ConsolidationError(f"JSON authority must be an object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_bytes(canonical_bytes(value))
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise ConsolidationError(message)
+
+
+def version_number(path: Path) -> int:
+    match = VERSION.search(path.name)
+    require(match is not None, f"versioned authority name required: {path.name}")
+    return int(match.group(1))
+
+
+def active_version(directory: Path, stem: str) -> Path:
+    matches = list(directory.glob(f"{stem}.v*.json"))
+    require(matches, f"missing authority {stem}.v*.json in {directory}")
+    by_version: dict[int, Path] = {}
+    for path in matches:
+        number = version_number(path)
+        require(number not in by_version, f"duplicate {stem} version {number} in {directory}")
+        by_version[number] = path
+    return by_version[max(by_version)]
+
+
+def validate_supersession_chain(directory: Path, stem: str, active: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    versions = sorted(directory.glob(f"{stem}.v*.json"), key=version_number)
+    chain: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for index, path in enumerate(versions):
+        value = read_json(path)
+        if index:
+            supersedes = value.get("supersedes")
+            if isinstance(supersedes, dict):
+                supersedes = supersedes.get("path")
+            if isinstance(supersedes, str):
+                supersedes = Path(supersedes).name
+            require(
+                supersedes in (None, versions[index - 1].name),
+                f"ambiguous {stem} supersession in {path}: {supersedes!r}",
+            )
+        chain.append(
+            {
+                "path": path.as_posix(),
+                "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+                "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+                "active": path == active,
+            }
+        )
+    return chain
+
+
+def validate_manifest(repo: Path, batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    active = active_version(batch_dir, "artifact-manifest")
+    manifest = read_json(active)
+    entries = manifest.get("artifacts")
+    require(isinstance(entries, list) and entries, f"empty artifact manifest: {active}")
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    authenticated: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        require(isinstance(entry, dict), f"invalid manifest entry in {active}")
+        relative = entry.get("path")
+        require(isinstance(relative, str) and relative not in seen, f"duplicate/bad path in {active}")
+        seen.add(relative)
+        path = repo / relative
+        require(path.is_file(), f"manifest artifact missing: {relative}")
+        actual_hash = sha256_file(path)
+        actual_size = path.stat().st_size
+        require(actual_hash == entry.get("sha256"), f"manifest hash mismatch: {relative}")
+        require(actual_size == entry.get("byte_length"), f"manifest byte length mismatch: {relative}")
+        authenticated.append(
+            {"path": relative, "sha256": actual_hash, "byte_length": actual_size}
+        )
+    return active, manifest, authenticated
+
+
+def parse_batch_number(batch_dir: Path) -> int:
+    match = re.search(r"batch-(\d{3})-", batch_dir.name)
+    require(match is not None, f"invalid batch directory: {batch_dir}")
+    return int(match.group(1))
+
+
+def source_inventory(batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    path = active_version(batch_dir, "source-evidence-inventory")
+    value = read_json(path)
+    require(isinstance(value.get("papers"), list), f"missing papers in {path}")
+    return path, value
+
+
+def active_terminal_authorities(batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, Path]:
+    return (
+        active_version(batch_dir, "verification-ledger"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "verified-structural-staging-shard"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "safe-rejection-queue"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "state-conservation-and-metrics"),
+    )
+
+
+def full_question_audit(
+    batch_dir: Path, question_ids: set[str]
+) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    matches: list[tuple[int, Path, dict[str, Any]]] = []
+    for path in batch_dir.glob("false-accept-false-override-audit.v*.json"):
+        value = read_json(path)
+        rows = value.get("rows")
+        if (
+            isinstance(rows, list)
+            and len(rows) == len(question_ids)
+            and {row.get("question_id") for row in rows} == question_ids
+        ):
+            matches.append((version_number(path), path, value))
+    require(matches, f"no full-question false-accept authority in {batch_dir}")
+    _, path, value = max(matches)
+    return path, value
+
+
+def paper_dimensions(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = PAPER_ID.match(paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, f"invalid paper id: {paper_id}")
+    session, year, paper, variant = match.groups()
+    return {
+        "session": session,
+        "year": 2000 + int(year),
+        "paper": int(paper),
+        "variant": int(variant),
+    }
+
+
+def paper_id_from_question_id(question_id: str) -> str:
+    require(question_id.startswith("qrow_"), f"invalid question id: {question_id}")
+    paper_id, separator, printed = question_id.removeprefix("qrow_").rpartition("_q")
+    require(separator == "_q" and printed.isdigit(), f"invalid question id: {question_id}")
+    paper_dimensions(paper_id)
+    return paper_id
+
+
+def require_hash(value: Any, context: str) -> None:
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(value) is not None, f"missing hash: {context}")
+
+
+def verification_hash_candidates(row: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    without_audit = {
+        key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "audit_hashes"
+    }
+    blank_hash = json.loads(json.dumps(row))
+    blank_hash["audit_hashes"]["verification_record_sha256"] = ""
+    return {
+        sha256_bytes(compact_canonical_bytes(without_audit)),
+        sha256_bytes(compact_canonical_bytes(blank_hash)),
+    }
+
+
+def evidence_records(row: dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[dict[str, Any]]:
+    question = row.get("question", {})
+    yield from question.get("authoritative_regions", [])
+    for node in row.get("structural_nodes", []):
+        yield from node.get("page_region_evidence", [])
+        yield from node.get("ms_evidence", [])
+
+
+def validate_staging_row(
+    row: dict[str, Any],
+    verification: dict[str, Any],
+    sources: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    question_id = row.get("question_id")
+    require(isinstance(question_id, str), "staging row missing question_id")
+    question = row.get("question")
+    require(isinstance(question, dict), f"staging row missing question: {question_id}")
+    require(question.get("question_id") == question_id, f"staging question id mismatch: {question_id}")
+    state = question.get("verification_state")
+    require(state in VERIFIED_STATES, f"non-verified state in staging: {question_id}: {state}")
+    require(verification.get("state") == state, f"staging/verification state mismatch: {question_id}")
+    require(
+        verification.get("final_disposition") == "verified_structural_staging",
+        f"bad final disposition: {question_id}",
+    )
+    paper_id = question.get("paper_id")
+    require(paper_id in sources, f"staging paper absent from source inventory: {question_id}")
+    membership = question.get("source_membership")
+    require(isinstance(membership, list) and len(membership) == 2, f"bad source membership: {question_id}")
+    expected_sources = {
+        sources[paper_id]["qp"]["source_object_id"],
+        sources[paper_id]["ms"]["source_object_id"],
+    }
+    require(set(membership) == expected_sources, f"source membership mismatch: {question_id}")
+    pages = question.get("complete_page_chain")
+    require(isinstance(pages, list) and pages, f"empty page chain: {question_id}")
+    require(pages == sorted(set(pages)), f"non-unique page chain: {question_id}")
+    require(question.get("start_page") == pages[0], f"start page mismatch: {question_id}")
+    provenance = question.get("provenance")
+    require(isinstance(provenance, dict), f"question provenance missing: {question_id}")
+    require_hash(provenance.get("inventory_sha256"), f"{question_id}.inventory")
+    require_hash(provenance.get("page_chain_manifest_sha256"), f"{question_id}.page_chain")
+
+    nodes = row.get("structural_nodes")
+    require(isinstance(nodes, list) and nodes, f"no structural nodes: {question_id}")
+    paths: set[str] = set()
+    pending_parents: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    node_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for node in nodes:
+        owner = node.get("owner_path")
+        require(isinstance(owner, str) and owner not in paths, f"duplicate node owner: {question_id}:{owner}")
+        parent = node.get("parent_owner_path")
+        if parent is not None:
+            require(isinstance(parent, str), f"invalid parent owner: {question_id}:{owner}")
+            pending_parents.append((owner, parent))
+        paths.add(owner)
+        node_rows.append(
+            {
+                "node_id": f"{question_id}::{owner}",
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "owner_path": owner,
+                "parent_node_id": None if parent is None else f"{question_id}::{parent}",
+                "role": node.get("role"),
+                "printed_marks": node.get("printed_marks"),
+                "page_region_count": len(node.get("page_region_evidence", [])),
+                "ms_evidence_count": len(node.get("ms_evidence", [])),
+            }
+        )
+    for owner, parent in pending_parents:
+        require(parent in paths, f"missing parent node: {question_id}:{owner}->{parent}")
+
+    for index, evidence in enumerate(evidence_records(row)):
+        require(isinstance(evidence, dict), f"invalid evidence record: {question_id}:{index}")
+        source_id = evidence.get("source_object_id")
+        require(source_id in expected_sources, f"unknown evidence source: {question_id}:{source_id}")
+        source_kind = "qp" if source_id == sources[paper_id]["qp"]["source_object_id"] else "ms"
+        require(
+            evidence.get("source_sha256") == sources[paper_id][source_kind]["sha256"],
+            f"evidence/source hash mismatch: {question_id}:{source_id}",
+        )
+        for key in ("source_sha256", "crop_sha256", "page_image_sha256", "evidence_manifest_sha256"):
+            require_hash(evidence.get(key), f"{question_id}.{key}")
+
+    audit_hashes = verification.get("audit_hashes")
+    require(isinstance(audit_hashes, dict) and audit_hashes, f"audit hashes missing: {question_id}")
+    for key, value in audit_hashes.items():
+        require_hash(value, f"{question_id}.audit_hashes.{key}")
+    return state, node_rows
+
+
+def validate_paper_source(repo: Path, paper: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    paper_id = paper.get("paper_id")
+    expected = paper_dimensions(paper_id)
+    for key, value in expected.items():
+        require(paper.get(key) == value, f"paper dimension mismatch: {paper_id}:{key}")
+    for kind in ("qp", "ms"):
+        source = paper.get(kind)
+        require(isinstance(source, dict), f"missing {kind} source: {paper_id}")
+        path = repo / source.get("source_path", "")
+        require(path.is_file(), f"source file missing: {path}")
+        require(path.stat().st_size == source.get("byte_length"), f"source size mismatch: {path}")
+        require(sha256_file(path) == source.get("sha256"), f"source hash mismatch: {path}")
+        require_hash(source.get("sha256"), f"{paper_id}.{kind}")
+    surface = repo / paper.get("surface_manifest", "")
+    require(surface.is_file(), f"surface manifest missing: {paper_id}")
+    require(sha256_file(surface) == paper.get("surface_manifest_sha256"), f"surface hash mismatch: {paper_id}")
+
+
+def matrix(records: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], dimensions: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    groups: dict[tuple[Any, ...], Counter[str]] = defaultdict(Counter)
+    papers: dict[tuple[Any, ...], set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    layouts: dict[tuple[Any, ...], set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    for record in records:
+        key = tuple(record[name] for name in dimensions)
+        groups[key][record["state"]] += 1
+        papers[key].add(record["paper_id"])
+        layouts[key].add(record["layout_family"])
+    result = []
+    for key in sorted(groups):
+        counts = groups[key]
+        row = {name: value for name, value in zip(dimensions, key)}
+        row.update(
+            {
+                "paper_count": len(papers[key]),
+                "question_count": sum(counts.values()),
+                "resolver_verified": counts["resolver_verified"],
+                "verified_agreement": counts["verified_agreement"],
+                "safe_rejection": counts["safe_rejection"],
+                "other_terminal": sum(
+                    value for state, value in counts.items() if state not in EXPECTED_STATES
+                ),
+                "layout_families": sorted(layouts[key]),
+            }
+        )
+        result.append(row)
+    return result
+
+
+def artifact_record(repo: Path, path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "path": path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+        "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def output_artifact_record(path: Path, logical_output: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "path": f"{logical_output}/{path.name}",
+        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+        "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def build(repo: Path, output: Path, validate_source_bytes: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    root = repo / "artifacts/method-map/v1-9709"
+    batches = sorted(root.glob("full-corpus-structural-batch-*"), key=parse_batch_number)
+    require(len(batches) == BATCH_COUNT, f"expected {BATCH_COUNT} batches, found {len(batches)}")
+    require([parse_batch_number(path) for path in batches] == list(range(1, 17)), "batch sequence gap")
+
+    inventory_path = root / "full-corpus-production-freeze-1650/inventory.v1.json"
+    inventory = read_json(inventory_path)
+    require(
+        inventory.get("summary", {}).get("eligible_paper_count") == EXPECTED_PAPERS,
+        "frozen inventory paper denominator changed",
+    )
+
+    batch_receipts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    papers: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    terminal: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    staging: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    safe_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    nodes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    coverage_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    provider_attempts = 0
+    historical_retries = 0
+    external_paid_calls = 0
+
+    for batch_dir in batches:
+        batch_number = parse_batch_number(batch_dir)
+        manifest_path, manifest, authenticated = validate_manifest(repo, batch_dir)
+        reconstruction_path = active_version(batch_dir, "deterministic-reconstruction")
+        reconstruction = read_json(reconstruction_path)
+        for field in (
+            "completed_provider_calls_repeated",
+            "completed_checker_reads_repeated",
+            "completed_resolver_reads_repeated",
+        ):
+            require(reconstruction.get(field, 0) == 0, f"{field} nonzero in batch {batch_number}")
+
+        verification_path, staging_path, safe_path, conservation_path = active_terminal_authorities(batch_dir)
+        source_path, source_value = source_inventory(batch_dir)
+        active_required = {
+            verification_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            staging_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            safe_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            conservation_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            source_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            reconstruction_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+        }
+        authenticated_paths = {entry["path"] for entry in authenticated}
+        require(
+            active_required <= authenticated_paths,
+            f"active authority missing from batch {batch_number} manifest: {sorted(active_required-authenticated_paths)}",
+        )
+
+        source_map: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for paper in source_value["papers"]:
+            paper_id = paper.get("paper_id")
+            require(isinstance(paper_id, str) and paper_id not in papers, f"overlapping paper ownership: {paper_id}")
+            require(paper_id not in source_map, f"duplicate batch paper: {paper_id}")
+            if validate_source_bytes:
+                validate_paper_source(repo, paper)
+            source_map[paper_id] = paper
+            papers[paper_id] = {
+                **paper,
+                "batch_number": batch_number,
+                "batch_id": manifest.get("batch_id"),
+            }
+
+        verification_value = read_json(verification_path)
+        staging_value = read_json(staging_path)
+        safe_value = read_json(safe_path)
+        conservation_value = read_json(conservation_path)
+        verification_rows = verification_value.get("rows")
+        staging_rows = staging_value.get("rows")
+        historical_rejected_rows = safe_value.get("rows")
+        require(isinstance(verification_rows, list), f"bad verification rows: {verification_path}")
+        require(isinstance(staging_rows, list), f"bad staging rows: {staging_path}")
+        require(isinstance(historical_rejected_rows, list), f"bad safe rejection rows: {safe_path}")
+        batch_verification: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for row in verification_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(isinstance(question_id, str) and question_id not in batch_verification, f"duplicate question in batch: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in terminal, f"overlapping question ownership: {question_id}")
+            state = row.get("state")
+            require(state in TERMINAL_STATES, f"nonterminal state: {question_id}:{state}")
+            paper_id = paper_id_from_question_id(question_id)
+            require(paper_id in source_map, f"verification paper absent from batch: {question_id}")
+            recorded_verification_hash = row.get("audit_hashes", {}).get(
+                "verification_record_sha256"
+            )
+            require_hash(recorded_verification_hash, f"{question_id}.verification_record")
+            require(
+                recorded_verification_hash in verification_hash_candidates(row),
+                f"verification record hash mismatch: {question_id}",
+            )
+            batch_verification[question_id] = row
+            terminal[question_id] = {
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "state": state,
+                "batch_number": batch_number,
+                "batch_id": manifest.get("batch_id"),
+                "verification_authority": verification_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+                "verification_record_sha256": row.get("audit_hashes", {}).get(
+                    "verification_record_sha256"
+                ),
+            }
+
+        for row in staging_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(question_id in batch_verification, f"staging without verification: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in staging, f"duplicate staging row: {question_id}")
+            state, node_rows = validate_staging_row(row, batch_verification[question_id], source_map)
+            staging[question_id] = row
+            question = row["question"]
+            dimensions = paper_dimensions(question["paper_id"])
+            coverage_records.append(
+                {
+                    "question_id": question_id,
+                    "paper_id": question["paper_id"],
+                    "state": state,
+                    "layout_family": question.get("layout_family", "unknown"),
+                    **dimensions,
+                }
+            )
+            for node in node_rows:
+                require(node["node_id"] not in nodes, f"duplicate global node id: {node['node_id']}")
+                nodes[node["node_id"]] = node
+
+        rejected_rows = [
+            row
+            for row in historical_rejected_rows
+            if batch_verification.get(row.get("question_id"), {}).get("state") == "safe_rejection"
+        ]
+        for row in rejected_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(question_id in batch_verification, f"safe rejection without verification: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in safe_rows, f"duplicate safe rejection: {question_id}")
+            paper_id = row.get("paper_id")
+            require(paper_id in source_map, f"safe rejection paper missing: {question_id}")
+            safe_rows[question_id] = {**row, "batch_number": batch_number}
+            coverage_records.append(
+                {
+                    "question_id": question_id,
+                    "paper_id": paper_id,
+                    "state": "safe_rejection",
+                    "layout_family": "unresolved_safe_rejection",
+                    **paper_dimensions(paper_id),
+                }
+            )
+
+        batch_state_counts = Counter(row["state"] for row in verification_rows)
+        require(
+            len(staging_rows)
+            == batch_state_counts["resolver_verified"] + batch_state_counts["verified_agreement"],
+            f"staging conservation failed: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+        require(len(rejected_rows) == batch_state_counts["safe_rejection"], f"safe rejection conservation failed: batch {batch_number}")
+        metric_batch = conservation_value.get("batch", conservation_value)
+        metric_denominator = metric_batch.get("membership_questions")
+        if metric_denominator is None and isinstance(metric_batch.get("state_counts"), dict):
+            metric_denominator = sum(metric_batch["state_counts"].values())
+        require(metric_denominator == len(verification_rows), f"metric denominator mismatch: batch {batch_number}")
+        metric_pass = metric_batch.get("conserved")
+        if metric_pass is None:
+            metric_pass = str(conservation_value.get("status", "")).lower() == "pass"

+        require(isinstance(relative, str) and relative not in seen, f"duplicate/bad path in {active}")
+        seen.add(relative)
+        path = repo / relative
+        require(path.is_file(), f"manifest artifact missing: {relative}")
+        actual_hash = sha256_file(path)
+        actual_size = path.stat().st_size
+        require(actual_hash == entry.get("sha256"), f"manifest hash mismatch: {relative}")
+        require(actual_size == entry.get("byte_length"), f"manifest byte length mismatch: {relative}")
+        authenticated.append(
+            {"path": relative, "sha256": actual_hash, "byte_length": actual_size}
+        )
+    return active, manifest, authenticated
+
+
+def parse_batch_number(batch_dir: Path) -> int:
+    match = re.search(r"batch-(\d{3})-", batch_dir.name)
+    require(match is not None, f"invalid batch directory: {batch_dir}")
+    return int(match.group(1))
+
+
+def source_inventory(batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    path = active_version(batch_dir, "source-evidence-inventory")
+    value = read_json(path)
+    require(isinstance(value.get("papers"), list), f"missing papers in {path}")
+    return path, value
+
+
+def active_terminal_authorities(batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, Path]:
+    return (
+        active_version(batch_dir, "verification-ledger"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "verified-structural-staging-shard"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "safe-rejection-queue"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "state-conservation-and-metrics"),
+    )
+
+
+def full_question_audit(
+    batch_dir: Path, question_ids: set[str]
+) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    matches: list[tuple[int, Path, dict[str, Any]]] = []
+    for path in batch_dir.glob("false-accept-false-override-audit.v*.json"):
+        value = read_json(path)
+        rows = value.get("rows")
+        if (
+            isinstance(rows, list)
+            and len(rows) == len(question_ids)
+            and {row.get("question_id") for row in rows} == question_ids
+        ):
+            matches.append((version_number(path), path, value))
+    require(matches, f"no full-question false-accept authority in {batch_dir}")
+    _, path, value = max(matches)
+    return path, value
+
+
+def paper_dimensions(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = PAPER_ID.match(paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, f"invalid paper id: {paper_id}")
+    session, year, paper, variant = match.groups()
+    return {
+        "session": session,
+        "year": 2000 + int(year),
+        "paper": int(paper),
+        "variant": int(variant),
+    }
+
+
+def paper_id_from_question_id(question_id: str) -> str:
+    require(question_id.startswith("qrow_"), f"invalid question id: {question_id}")
+    paper_id, separator, printed = question_id.removeprefix("qrow_").rpartition("_q")
+    require(separator == "_q" and printed.isdigit(), f"invalid question id: {question_id}")
+    paper_dimensions(paper_id)
+    return paper_id
+
+
+def require_hash(value: Any, context: str) -> None:
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(value) is not None, f"missing hash: {context}")
+
+
+def verification_hash_candidates(row: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    without_audit = {
+        key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "audit_hashes"
+    }
+    blank_hash = json.loads(json.dumps(row))
+    blank_hash["audit_hashes"]["verification_record_sha256"] = ""
+    return {
+        sha256_bytes(compact_canonical_bytes(without_audit)),
+        sha256_bytes(compact_canonical_bytes(blank_hash)),
+    }
+
+
+def evidence_records(row: dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[dict[str, Any]]:
+    question = row.get("question", {})
+    yield from question.get("authoritative_regions", [])
+    for node in row.get("structural_nodes", []):
+        yield from node.get("page_region_evidence", [])
+        yield from node.get("ms_evidence", [])
+
+
+def validate_staging_row(
+    row: dict[str, Any],
+    verification: dict[str, Any],
+    sources: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    question_id = row.get("question_id")
+    require(isinstance(question_id, str), "staging row missing question_id")
+    question = row.get("question")
+    require(isinstance(question, dict), f"staging row missing question: {question_id}")
+    require(question.get("question_id") == question_id, f"staging question id mismatch: {question_id}")
+    state = question.get("verification_state")
+    require(state in VERIFIED_STATES, f"non-verified state in staging: {question_id}: {state}")
+    require(verification.get("state") == state, f"staging/verification state mismatch: {question_id}")
+    require(
+        verification.get("final_disposition") == "verified_structural_staging",
+        f"bad final disposition: {question_id}",
+    )
+    paper_id = question.get("paper_id")
+    require(paper_id in sources, f"staging paper absent from source inventory: {question_id}")
+    membership = question.get("source_membership")
+    require(isinstance(membership, list) and len(membership) == 2, f"bad source membership: {question_id}")
+    expected_sources = {
+        sources[paper_id]["qp"]["source_object_id"],
+        sources[paper_id]["ms"]["source_object_id"],
+    }
+    require(set(membership) == expected_sources, f"source membership mismatch: {question_id}")
+    pages = question.get("complete_page_chain")
+    require(isinstance(pages, list) and pages, f"empty page chain: {question_id}")
+    require(pages == sorted(set(pages)), f"non-unique page chain: {question_id}")
+    require(question.get("start_page") == pages[0], f"start page mismatch: {question_id}")
+    provenance = question.get("provenance")
+    require(isinstance(provenance, dict), f"question provenance missing: {question_id}")
+    require_hash(provenance.get("inventory_sha256"), f"{question_id}.inventory")
+    require_hash(provenance.get("page_chain_manifest_sha256"), f"{question_id}.page_chain")
+
+    nodes = row.get("structural_nodes")
+    require(isinstance(nodes, list) and nodes, f"no structural nodes: {question_id}")
+    paths: set[str] = set()
+    pending_parents: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    node_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for node in nodes:
+        owner = node.get("owner_path")
+        require(isinstance(owner, str) and owner not in paths, f"duplicate node owner: {question_id}:{owner}")
+        parent = node.get("parent_owner_path")
+        if parent is not None:
+            require(isinstance(parent, str), f"invalid parent owner: {question_id}:{owner}")
+            pending_parents.append((owner, parent))
+        paths.add(owner)
+        node_rows.append(
+            {
+                "node_id": f"{question_id}::{owner}",
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "owner_path": owner,
+                "parent_node_id": None if parent is None else f"{question_id}::{parent}",
+                "role": node.get("role"),
+                "printed_marks": node.get("printed_marks"),
+                "page_region_count": len(node.get("page_region_evidence", [])),
+                "ms_evidence_count": len(node.get("ms_evidence", [])),
+            }
+        )
+    for owner, parent in pending_parents:
+        require(parent in paths, f"missing parent node: {question_id}:{owner}->{parent}")
+
+    for index, evidence in enumerate(evidence_records(row)):
+        require(isinstance(evidence, dict), f"invalid evidence record: {question_id}:{index}")
+        source_id = evidence.get("source_object_id")
+        require(source_id in expected_sources, f"unknown evidence source: {question_id}:{source_id}")
+        source_kind = "qp" if source_id == sources[paper_id]["qp"]["source_object_id"] else "ms"
+        require(
+            evidence.get("source_sha256") == sources[paper_id][source_kind]["sha256"],
+            f"evidence/source hash mismatch: {question_id}:{source_id}",
+        )
+        for key in ("source_sha256", "crop_sha256", "page_image_sha256", "evidence_manifest_sha256"):
+            require_hash(evidence.get(key), f"{question_id}.{key}")
+
+    audit_hashes = verification.get("audit_hashes")
+    require(isinstance(audit_hashes, dict) and audit_hashes, f"audit hashes missing: {question_id}")
+    for key, value in audit_hashes.items():
+        require_hash(value, f"{question_id}.audit_hashes.{key}")
+    return state, node_rows
+
+
+def validate_paper_source(repo: Path, paper: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    paper_id = paper.get("paper_id")
+    expected = paper_dimensions(paper_id)
+    for key, value in expected.items():
+        require(paper.get(key) == value, f"paper dimension mismatch: {paper_id}:{key}")
+    for kind in ("qp", "ms"):
+        source = paper.get(kind)
+        require(isinstance(source, dict), f"missing {kind} source: {paper_id}")
+        path = repo / source.get("source_path", "")
+        require(path.is_file(), f"source file missing: {path}")
+        require(path.stat().st_size == source.get("byte_length"), f"source size mismatch: {path}")
+        require(sha256_file(path) == source.get("sha256"), f"source hash mismatch: {path}")
+        require_hash(source.get("sha256"), f"{paper_id}.{kind}")
+    surface = repo / paper.get("surface_manifest", "")
+    require(surface.is_file(), f"surface manifest missing: {paper_id}")
+    require(sha256_file(surface) == paper.get("surface_manifest_sha256"), f"surface hash mismatch: {paper_id}")
+
+
+def matrix(records: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], dimensions: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    groups: dict[tuple[Any, ...], Counter[str]] = defaultdict(Counter)
+    papers: dict[tuple[Any, ...], set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    layouts: dict[tuple[Any, ...], set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    for record in records:
+        key = tuple(record[name] for name in dimensions)
+        groups[key][record["state"]] += 1
+        papers[key].add(record["paper_id"])
+        layouts[key].add(record["layout_family"])
+    result = []
+    for key in sorted(groups):
+        counts = groups[key]
+        row = {name: value for name, value in zip(dimensions, key)}
+        row.update(
+            {
+                "paper_count": len(papers[key]),
+                "question_count": sum(counts.values()),
+                "resolver_verified": counts["resolver_verified"],
+                "verified_agreement": counts["verified_agreement"],
+                "safe_rejection": counts["safe_rejection"],
+                "other_terminal": sum(
+                    value for state, value in counts.items() if state not in EXPECTED_STATES
+                ),
+                "layout_families": sorted(layouts[key]),
+            }
+        )
+        result.append(row)
+    return result
+
+
+def artifact_record(repo: Path, path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "path": path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+        "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def output_artifact_record(path: Path, logical_output: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "path": f"{logical_output}/{path.name}",
+        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+        "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def build(repo: Path, output: Path, validate_source_bytes: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    root = repo / "artifacts/method-map/v1-9709"
+    batches = sorted(root.glob("full-corpus-structural-batch-*"), key=parse_batch_number)
+    require(len(batches) == BATCH_COUNT, f"expected {BATCH_COUNT} batches, found {len(batches)}")
+    require([parse_batch_number(path) for path in batches] == list(range(1, 17)), "batch sequence gap")
+
+    inventory_path = root / "full-corpus-production-freeze-1650/inventory.v1.json"
+    inventory = read_json(inventory_path)
+    require(
+        inventory.get("summary", {}).get("eligible_paper_count") == EXPECTED_PAPERS,
+        "frozen inventory paper denominator changed",
+    )
+
+    batch_receipts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    papers: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    terminal: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    staging: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    safe_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    nodes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    coverage_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    provider_attempts = 0
+    historical_retries = 0
+    external_paid_calls = 0
+
+    for batch_dir in batches:
+        batch_number = parse_batch_number(batch_dir)
+        manifest_path, manifest, authenticated = validate_manifest(repo, batch_dir)
+        reconstruction_path = active_version(batch_dir, "deterministic-reconstruction")
+        reconstruction = read_json(reconstruction_path)
+        for field in (
+            "completed_provider_calls_repeated",
+            "completed_checker_reads_repeated",
+            "completed_resolver_reads_repeated",
+        ):
+            require(reconstruction.get(field, 0) == 0, f"{field} nonzero in batch {batch_number}")
+
+        verification_path, staging_path, safe_path, conservation_path = active_terminal_authorities(batch_dir)
+        source_path, source_value = source_inventory(batch_dir)
+        active_required = {
+            verification_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            staging_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            safe_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            conservation_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            source_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            reconstruction_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+        }
+        authenticated_paths = {entry["path"] for entry in authenticated}
+        require(
+            active_required <= authenticated_paths,
+            f"active authority missing from batch {batch_number} manifest: {sorted(active_required-authenticated_paths)}",
+        )
+
+        source_map: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for paper in source_value["papers"]:
+            paper_id = paper.get("paper_id")
+            require(isinstance(paper_id, str) and paper_id not in papers, f"overlapping paper ownership: {paper_id}")
+            require(paper_id not in source_map, f"duplicate batch paper: {paper_id}")
+            if validate_source_bytes:
+                validate_paper_source(repo, paper)
+            source_map[paper_id] = paper
+            papers[paper_id] = {
+                **paper,
+                "batch_number": batch_number,
+                "batch_id": manifest.get("batch_id"),
+            }
+
+        verification_value = read_json(verification_path)
+        staging_value = read_json(staging_path)
+        safe_value = read_json(safe_path)
+        conservation_value = read_json(conservation_path)
+        verification_rows = verification_value.get("rows")
+        staging_rows = staging_value.get("rows")
+        historical_rejected_rows = safe_value.get("rows")
+        require(isinstance(verification_rows, list), f"bad verification rows: {verification_path}")
+        require(isinstance(staging_rows, list), f"bad staging rows: {staging_path}")
+        require(isinstance(historical_rejected_rows, list), f"bad safe rejection rows: {safe_path}")
+        batch_verification: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for row in verification_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(isinstance(question_id, str) and question_id not in batch_verification, f"duplicate question in batch: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in terminal, f"overlapping question ownership: {question_id}")
+            state = row.get("state")
+            require(state in TERMINAL_STATES, f"nonterminal state: {question_id}:{state}")
+            paper_id = paper_id_from_question_id(question_id)
+            require(paper_id in source_map, f"verification paper absent from batch: {question_id}")
+            recorded_verification_hash = row.get("audit_hashes", {}).get(
+                "verification_record_sha256"
+            )
+            require_hash(recorded_verification_hash, f"{question_id}.verification_record")
+            require(
+                recorded_verification_hash in verification_hash_candidates(row),
+                f"verification record hash mismatch: {question_id}",
+            )
+            batch_verification[question_id] = row
+            terminal[question_id] = {
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "state": state,
+                "batch_number": batch_number,
+                "batch_id": manifest.get("batch_id"),
+                "verification_authority": verification_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+                "verification_record_sha256": row.get("audit_hashes", {}).get(
+                    "verification_record_sha256"
+                ),
+            }
+
+        for row in staging_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(question_id in batch_verification, f"staging without verification: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in staging, f"duplicate staging row: {question_id}")
+            state, node_rows = validate_staging_row(row, batch_verification[question_id], source_map)
+            staging[question_id] = row
+            question = row["question"]
+            dimensions = paper_dimensions(question["paper_id"])
+            coverage_records.append(
+                {
+                    "question_id": question_id,
+                    "paper_id": question["paper_id"],
+                    "state": state,
+                    "layout_family": question.get("layout_family", "unknown"),
+                    **dimensions,
+                }
+            )
+            for node in node_rows:
+                require(node["node_id"] not in nodes, f"duplicate global node id: {node['node_id']}")
+                nodes[node["node_id"]] = node
+
+        rejected_rows = [
+            row
+            for row in historical_rejected_rows
+            if batch_verification.get(row.get("question_id"), {}).get("state") == "safe_rejection"
+        ]
+        for row in rejected_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(question_id in batch_verification, f"safe rejection without verification: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in safe_rows, f"duplicate safe rejection: {question_id}")
+            paper_id = row.get("paper_id")
+            require(paper_id in source_map, f"safe rejection paper missing: {question_id}")
+            safe_rows[question_id] = {**row, "batch_number": batch_number}
+            coverage_records.append(
+                {
+                    "question_id": question_id,
+                    "paper_id": paper_id,
+                    "state": "safe_rejection",
+                    "layout_family": "unresolved_safe_rejection",
+                    **paper_dimensions(paper_id),
+                }
+            )
+
+        batch_state_counts = Counter(row["state"] for row in verification_rows)
+        require(
+            len(staging_rows)
+            == batch_state_counts["resolver_verified"] + batch_state_counts["verified_agreement"],
+            f"staging conservation failed: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+        require(len(rejected_rows) == batch_state_counts["safe_rejection"], f"safe rejection conservation failed: batch {batch_number}")
+        metric_batch = conservation_value.get("batch", conservation_value)
+        metric_denominator = metric_batch.get("membership_questions")
+        if metric_denominator is None and isinstance(metric_batch.get("state_counts"), dict):
+            metric_denominator = sum(metric_batch["state_counts"].values())
+        require(metric_denominator == len(verification_rows), f"metric denominator mismatch: batch {batch_number}")
+        metric_pass = metric_batch.get("conserved")
+        if metric_pass is None:
+            metric_pass = str(conservation_value.get("status", "")).lower() == "pass"
+        require(metric_pass, f"batch conservation not PASS: batch {batch_number}")
+
+        provider_path = active_version(batch_dir, "provider-context-retry-cost-receipt")
+        provider = read_json(provider_path)
+        require(
+            provider_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix() in authenticated_paths,
+            f"provider authority absent from manifest: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+        attempts = provider.get(
+            "provider_attempt_count",
+            provider.get(
+                "provider_attempts",
+                provider.get("attempts", provider.get("local_provider_attempts", 0)),
+            ),
+        )
+        if isinstance(attempts, dict):
+            attempts = attempts.get("total", 0)
+        provider_attempts += int(attempts or 0)
+        historical_retries += int(provider.get("retry_count", 0) or 0)
+        external_paid_calls += int(
+            provider.get(
+                "external_or_paid_vlm_calls",
+                provider.get(
+                    "external_or_paid_calls", provider.get("external_paid_calls", 0)
+                ),
+            )
+            or 0
+        )
+
+        false_audit_path, false_audit = full_question_audit(
+            batch_dir, set(batch_verification)
+        )
+        false_rows = false_audit.get("rows")
+        require(
+            isinstance(false_rows, list) and len(false_rows) == len(verification_rows),
+            f"false-accept audit denominator mismatch: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+        require(
+            {row.get("question_id") for row in false_rows} == set(batch_verification),
+            f"false-accept audit identity mismatch: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+        require(
+            not any(row.get("false_accept") or row.get("false_override") for row in false_rows),
+            f"false accept/override detected: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+        active_required.add(false_audit_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix())
+        require(
+            false_audit_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix() in authenticated_paths,
+            f"false-accept authority absent from manifest: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+
+        batch_receipts.append(
+            {
+                "batch_number": batch_number,
+                "batch_id": manifest.get("batch_id"),
+                "issue": manifest.get("issue"),
+                "directory": batch_dir.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+                "active_manifest": artifact_record(repo, manifest_path),
+                "active_reconstruction": artifact_record(repo, reconstruction_path),
+                "active_verification": artifact_record(repo, verification_path),
+                "active_staging": artifact_record(repo, staging_path),
+                "active_safe_rejection_queue": artifact_record(repo, safe_path),
+                "active_source_inventory": artifact_record(repo, source_path),
+                "active_state_conservation": artifact_record(repo, conservation_path),
+                "active_false_accept_audit": artifact_record(repo, false_audit_path),
+                "active_provider_receipt": artifact_record(repo, provider_path),
+                "manifest_authenticated_artifact_count": len(authenticated),
+                "manifest_authenticated_byte_count": sum(row["byte_length"] for row in authenticated),
+                "manifest_supersession_chain": validate_supersession_chain(
+                    batch_dir, "artifact-manifest", manifest_path
+                ),
+                "reconstruction_supersession_chain": validate_supersession_chain(
+                    batch_dir, "deterministic-reconstruction", reconstruction_path
+                ),
+                "active_authority_supersession_chains": {
+                    stem: validate_supersession_chain(
+                        batch_dir, stem, active_version(batch_dir, stem)
+                    )
+                    for stem in (
+                        "verification-ledger",
+                        "verified-structural-staging-shard",
+                        "safe-rejection-queue",
+                        "source-evidence-inventory",
+                        "state-conservation-and-metrics",
+                        "provider-context-retry-cost-receipt",
+                        "false-accept-false-override-audit",
+                    )
+                },
+                "paper_count": len(source_map),
+                "terminal_question_count": len(verification_rows),
+                "state_counts": dict(sorted(batch_state_counts.items())),
+                "verified_staging_count": len(staging_rows),
+                "safe_rejection_count": len(rejected_rows),
+                "status": "PASS",
+            }
+        )
+
+    state_counts = Counter(row["state"] for row in terminal.values())

When any frozen authority fails validation during a rerun, the existing output directory has already been recursively deleted before `build` raises, so a failed validation destroys the last valid consolidation instead of failing closed; a later write failure can likewise leave a partial tree. Build and replay into a temporary sibling first, then replace the existing output only after all checks complete.

When a version declares `supersedes` as an object, the validator discards every field except `path`, so a predecessor whose bytes no longer match the declared `sha256` is still accepted as an authenticated chain. +        "source_ambiguity",
+        "formally_excluded",
+        "provider_or_transport_failure",
+    }
+)
+HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+VERSION = re.compile(r"\.v(\d+)\.json$")
+PAPER_ID = re.compile(r"^9709_([msw])(\d{2})_qp_([1-6])(\d)$")
+
+
+class ConsolidationError(RuntimeError):
+    """A fail-closed frozen-authority validation error."""
+
+
+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def compact_canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(
+        value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
+    ).encode()
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ConsolidationError(f"unreadable JSON authority: {path}: {exc}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ConsolidationError(f"JSON authority must be an object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_bytes(canonical_bytes(value))
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise ConsolidationError(message)
+
+
+def version_number(path: Path) -> int:
+    match = VERSION.search(path.name)
+    require(match is not None, f"versioned authority name required: {path.name}")
+    return int(match.group(1))
+
+
+def active_version(directory: Path, stem: str) -> Path:
+    matches = list(directory.glob(f"{stem}.v*.json"))
+    require(matches, f"missing authority {stem}.v*.json in {directory}")
+    by_version: dict[int, Path] = {}
+    for path in matches:
+        number = version_number(path)
+        require(number not in by_version, f"duplicate {stem} version {number} in {directory}")
+        by_version[number] = path
+    return by_version[max(by_version)]
+
+
+def validate_supersession_chain(directory: Path, stem: str, active: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    versions = sorted(directory.glob(f"{stem}.v*.json"), key=version_number)
+    chain: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for index, path in enumerate(versions):
+        value = read_json(path)
+        if index:
+            supersedes = value.get("supersedes")
+            if isinstance(supersedes, dict):
+                supersedes = supersedes.get("path")
+            if isinstance(supersedes, str):
+                supersedes = Path(supersedes).name
+            require(
+                supersedes in (None, versions[index - 1].name),
+                f"ambiguous {stem} supersession in {path}: {supersedes!r}",
+            )
+        chain.append(
+            {
+                "path": path.as_posix(),
+                "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+                "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+                "active": path == active,
+            }
+        )
+    return chain
+
+
+def validate_manifest(repo: Path, batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    active = active_version(batch_dir, "artifact-manifest")
+    manifest = read_json(active)
+    entries = manifest.get("artifacts")
+    require(isinstance(entries, list) and entries, f"empty artifact manifest: {active}")
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    authenticated: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        require(isinstance(entry, dict), f"invalid manifest entry in {active}")
+        relative = entry.get("path")
+        require(isinstance(relative, str) and relative not in seen, f"duplicate/bad path in {active}")
+        seen.add(relative)
+        path = repo / relative
+        require(path.is_file(), f"manifest artifact missing: {relative}")
+        actual_hash = sha256_file(path)
+        actual_size = path.stat().st_size
+        require(actual_hash == entry.get("sha256"), f"manifest hash mismatch: {relative}")
+        require(actual_size == entry.get("byte_length"), f"manifest byte length mismatch: {relative}")
+        authenticated.append(
+            {"path": relative, "sha256": actual_hash, "byte_length": actual_size}
+        )
+    return active, manifest, authenticated
+
+
+def parse_batch_number(batch_dir: Path) -> int:
+    match = re.search(r"batch-(\d{3})-", batch_dir.name)
+    require(match is not None, f"invalid batch directory: {batch_dir}")
+    return int(match.group(1))
+
+
+def source_inventory(batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    path = active_version(batch_dir, "source-evidence-inventory")
+    value = read_json(path)
+    require(isinstance(value.get("papers"), list), f"missing papers in {path}")
+    return path, value
+
+
+def active_terminal_authorities(batch_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, Path]:
+    return (
+        active_version(batch_dir, "verification-ledger"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "verified-structural-staging-shard"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "safe-rejection-queue"),
+        active_version(batch_dir, "state-conservation-and-metrics"),
+    )
+
+
+def full_question_audit(
+    batch_dir: Path, question_ids: set[str]
+) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    matches: list[tuple[int, Path, dict[str, Any]]] = []
+    for path in batch_dir.glob("false-accept-false-override-audit.v*.json"):
+        value = read_json(path)
+        rows = value.get("rows")
+        if (
+            isinstance(rows, list)
+            and len(rows) == len(question_ids)
+            and {row.get("question_id") for row in rows} == question_ids
+        ):
+            matches.append((version_number(path), path, value))
+    require(matches, f"no full-question false-accept authority in {batch_dir}")
+    _, path, value = max(matches)
+    return path, value
+
+
+def paper_dimensions(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = PAPER_ID.match(paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, f"invalid paper id: {paper_id}")
+    session, year, paper, variant = match.groups()
+    return {
+        "session": session,
+        "year": 2000 + int(year),
+        "paper": int(paper),
+        "variant": int(variant),
+    }
+
+
+def paper_id_from_question_id(question_id: str) -> str:
+    require(question_id.startswith("qrow_"), f"invalid question id: {question_id}")
+    paper_id, separator, printed = question_id.removeprefix("qrow_").rpartition("_q")
+    require(separator == "_q" and printed.isdigit(), f"invalid question id: {question_id}")
+    paper_dimensions(paper_id)
+    return paper_id
+
+
+def require_hash(value: Any, context: str) -> None:
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(value) is not None, f"missing hash: {context}")
+
+
+def verification_hash_candidates(row: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    without_audit = {
+        key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "audit_hashes"
+    }
+    blank_hash = json.loads(json.dumps(row))
+    blank_hash["audit_hashes"]["verification_record_sha256"] = ""
+    return {
+        sha256_bytes(compact_canonical_bytes(without_audit)),
+        sha256_bytes(compact_canonical_bytes(blank_hash)),
+    }
+
+
+def evidence_records(row: dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[dict[str, Any]]:
+    question = row.get("question", {})
+    yield from question.get("authoritative_regions", [])
+    for node in row.get("structural_nodes", []):
+        yield from node.get("page_region_evidence", [])
+        yield from node.get("ms_evidence", [])
+
+
+def validate_staging_row(
+    row: dict[str, Any],
+    verification: dict[str, Any],
+    sources: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    question_id = row.get("question_id")
+    require(isinstance(question_id, str), "staging row missing question_id")
+    question = row.get("question")
+    require(isinstance(question, dict), f"staging row missing question: {question_id}")
+    require(question.get("question_id") == question_id, f"staging question id mismatch: {question_id}")
+    state = question.get("verification_state")
+    require(state in VERIFIED_STATES, f"non-verified state in staging: {question_id}: {state}")
+    require(verification.get("state") == state, f"staging/verification state mismatch: {question_id}")
+    require(
+        verification.get("final_disposition") == "verified_structural_staging",
+        f"bad final disposition: {question_id}",
+    )
+    paper_id = question.get("paper_id")
+    require(paper_id in sources, f"staging paper absent from source inventory: {question_id}")
+    membership = question.get("source_membership")
+    require(isinstance(membership, list) and len(membership) == 2, f"bad source membership: {question_id}")
+    expected_sources = {
+        sources[paper_id]["qp"]["source_object_id"],
+        sources[paper_id]["ms"]["source_object_id"],
+    }
+    require(set(membership) == expected_sources, f"source membership mismatch: {question_id}")
+    pages = question.get("complete_page_chain")
+    require(isinstance(pages, list) and pages, f"empty page chain: {question_id}")
+    require(pages == sorted(set(pages)), f"non-unique page chain: {question_id}")
+    require(question.get("start_page") == pages[0], f"start page mismatch: {question_id}")
+    provenance = question.get("provenance")
+    require(isinstance(provenance, dict), f"question provenance missing: {question_id}")
+    require_hash(provenance.get("inventory_sha256"), f"{question_id}.inventory")
+    require_hash(provenance.get("page_chain_manifest_sha256"), f"{question_id}.page_chain")
+
+    nodes = row.get("structural_nodes")
+    require(isinstance(nodes, list) and nodes, f"no structural nodes: {question_id}")
+    paths: set[str] = set()
+    pending_parents: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    node_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for node in nodes:
+        owner = node.get("owner_path")
+        require(isinstance(owner, str) and owner not in paths, f"duplicate node owner: {question_id}:{owner}")
+        parent = node.get("parent_owner_path")
+        if parent is not None:
+            require(isinstance(parent, str), f"invalid parent owner: {question_id}:{owner}")
+            pending_parents.append((owner, parent))
+        paths.add(owner)
+        node_rows.append(
+            {
+                "node_id": f"{question_id}::{owner}",
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "owner_path": owner,
+                "parent_node_id": None if parent is None else f"{question_id}::{parent}",
+                "role": node.get("role"),
+                "printed_marks": node.get("printed_marks"),
+                "page_region_count": len(node.get("page_region_evidence", [])),
+                "ms_evidence_count": len(node.get("ms_evidence", [])),
+            }
+        )
+    for owner, parent in pending_parents:
+        require(parent in paths, f"missing parent node: {question_id}:{owner}->{parent}")
+
+    for index, evidence in enumerate(evidence_records(row)):
+        require(isinstance(evidence, dict), f"invalid evidence record: {question_id}:{index}")
+        source_id = evidence.get("source_object_id")
+        require(source_id in expected_sources, f"unknown evidence source: {question_id}:{source_id}")
+        source_kind = "qp" if source_id == sources[paper_id]["qp"]["source_object_id"] else "ms"
+        require(
+            evidence.get("source_sha256") == sources[paper_id][source_kind]["sha256"],
+            f"evidence/source hash mismatch: {question_id}:{source_id}",
+        )
+        for key in ("source_sha256", "crop_sha256", "page_image_sha256", "evidence_manifest_sha256"):
+            require_hash(evidence.get(key), f"{question_id}.{key}")
+
+    audit_hashes = verification.get("audit_hashes")
+    require(isinstance(audit_hashes, dict) and audit_hashes, f"audit hashes missing: {question_id}")
+    for key, value in audit_hashes.items():
+        require_hash(value, f"{question_id}.audit_hashes.{key}")
+    return state, node_rows
+
+
+def validate_paper_source(repo: Path, paper: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    paper_id = paper.get("paper_id")
+    expected = paper_dimensions(paper_id)
+    for key, value in expected.items():
+        require(paper.get(key) == value, f"paper dimension mismatch: {paper_id}:{key}")
+    for kind in ("qp", "ms"):
+        source = paper.get(kind)
+        require(isinstance(source, dict), f"missing {kind} source: {paper_id}")
+        path = repo / source.get("source_path", "")
+        require(path.is_file(), f"source file missing: {path}")
+        require(path.stat().st_size == source.get("byte_length"), f"source size mismatch: {path}")
+        require(sha256_file(path) == source.get("sha256"), f"source hash mismatch: {path}")
+        require_hash(source.get("sha256"), f"{paper_id}.{kind}")
+    surface = repo / paper.get("surface_manifest", "")
+    require(surface.is_file(), f"surface manifest missing: {paper_id}")
+    require(sha256_file(surface) == paper.get("surface_manifest_sha256"), f"surface hash mismatch: {paper_id}")
+
+
+def matrix(records: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], dimensions: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    groups: dict[tuple[Any, ...], Counter[str]] = defaultdict(Counter)
+    papers: dict[tuple[Any, ...], set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    layouts: dict[tuple[Any, ...], set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    for record in records:
+        key = tuple(record[name] for name in dimensions)
+        groups[key][record["state"]] += 1
+        papers[key].add(record["paper_id"])
+        layouts[key].add(record["layout_family"])
+    result = []
+    for key in sorted(groups):
+        counts = groups[key]
+        row = {name: value for name, value in zip(dimensions, key)}
+        row.update(
+            {
+                "paper_count": len(papers[key]),
+                "question_count": sum(counts.values()),
+                "resolver_verified": counts["resolver_verified"],
+                "verified_agreement": counts["verified_agreement"],
+                "safe_rejection": counts["safe_rejection"],
+                "other_terminal": sum(
+                    value for state, value in counts.items() if state not in EXPECTED_STATES
+                ),
+                "layout_families": sorted(layouts[key]),
+            }
+        )
+        result.append(row)
+    return result
+
+
+def artifact_record(repo: Path, path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "path": path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+        "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def output_artifact_record(path: Path, logical_output: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "path": f"{logical_output}/{path.name}",
+        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+        "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def build(repo: Path, output: Path, validate_source_bytes: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    root = repo / "artifacts/method-map/v1-9709"
+    batches = sorted(root.glob("full-corpus-structural-batch-*"), key=parse_batch_number)
+    require(len(batches) == BATCH_COUNT, f"expected {BATCH_COUNT} batches, found {len(batches)}")
+    require([parse_batch_number(path) for path in batches] == list(range(1, 17)), "batch sequence gap")
+
+    inventory_path = root / "full-corpus-production-freeze-1650/inventory.v1.json"
+    inventory = read_json(inventory_path)
+    require(
+        inventory.get("summary", {}).get("eligible_paper_count") == EXPECTED_PAPERS,
+        "frozen inventory paper denominator changed",
+    )
+
+    batch_receipts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    papers: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    terminal: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    staging: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    safe_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    nodes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    coverage_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    provider_attempts = 0
+    historical_retries = 0
+    external_paid_calls = 0
+
+    for batch_dir in batches:
+        batch_number = parse_batch_number(batch_dir)
+        manifest_path, manifest, authenticated = validate_manifest(repo, batch_dir)
+        reconstruction_path = active_version(batch_dir, "deterministic-reconstruction")
+        reconstruction = read_json(reconstruction_path)
+        for field in (
+            "completed_provider_calls_repeated",
+            "completed_checker_reads_repeated",
+            "completed_resolver_reads_repeated",
+        ):
+            require(reconstruction.get(field, 0) == 0, f"{field} nonzero in batch {batch_number}")
+
+        verification_path, staging_path, safe_path, conservation_path = active_terminal_authorities(batch_dir)
+        source_path, source_value = source_inventory(batch_dir)
+        active_required = {
+            verification_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            staging_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            safe_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            conservation_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            source_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+            reconstruction_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+        }
+        authenticated_paths = {entry["path"] for entry in authenticated}
+        require(
+            active_required <= authenticated_paths,
+            f"active authority missing from batch {batch_number} manifest: {sorted(active_required-authenticated_paths)}",
+        )
+
+        source_map: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for paper in source_value["papers"]:
+            paper_id = paper.get("paper_id")
+            require(isinstance(paper_id, str) and paper_id not in papers, f"overlapping paper ownership: {paper_id}")
+            require(paper_id not in source_map, f"duplicate batch paper: {paper_id}")
+            if validate_source_bytes:
+                validate_paper_source(repo, paper)
+            source_map[paper_id] = paper
+            papers[paper_id] = {
+                **paper,
+                "batch_number": batch_number,
+                "batch_id": manifest.get("batch_id"),
+            }
+
+        verification_value = read_json(verification_path)
+        staging_value = read_json(staging_path)
+        safe_value = read_json(safe_path)
+        conservation_value = read_json(conservation_path)
+        verification_rows = verification_value.get("rows")
+        staging_rows = staging_value.get("rows")
+        historical_rejected_rows = safe_value.get("rows")
+        require(isinstance(verification_rows, list), f"bad verification rows: {verification_path}")
+        require(isinstance(staging_rows, list), f"bad staging rows: {staging_path}")
+        require(isinstance(historical_rejected_rows, list), f"bad safe rejection rows: {safe_path}")
+        batch_verification: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for row in verification_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(isinstance(question_id, str) and question_id not in batch_verification, f"duplicate question in batch: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in terminal, f"overlapping question ownership: {question_id}")
+            state = row.get("state")
+            require(state in TERMINAL_STATES, f"nonterminal state: {question_id}:{state}")
+            paper_id = paper_id_from_question_id(question_id)
+            require(paper_id in source_map, f"verification paper absent from batch: {question_id}")
+            recorded_verification_hash = row.get("audit_hashes", {}).get(
+                "verification_record_sha256"
+            )
+            require_hash(recorded_verification_hash, f"{question_id}.verification_record")
+            require(
+                recorded_verification_hash in verification_hash_candidates(row),
+                f"verification record hash mismatch: {question_id}",
+            )
+            batch_verification[question_id] = row
+            terminal[question_id] = {
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "state": state,
+                "batch_number": batch_number,
+                "batch_id": manifest.get("batch_id"),
+                "verification_authority": verification_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),
+                "verification_record_sha256": row.get("audit_hashes", {}).get(
+                    "verification_record_sha256"
+                ),
+            }
+
+        for row in staging_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(question_id in batch_verification, f"staging without verification: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in staging, f"duplicate staging row: {question_id}")
+            state, node_rows = validate_staging_row(row, batch_verification[question_id], source_map)
+            staging[question_id] = row
+            question = row["question"]
+            dimensions = paper_dimensions(question["paper_id"])
+            coverage_records.append(
+                {
+                    "question_id": question_id,
+                    "paper_id": question["paper_id"],
+                    "state": state,
+                    "layout_family": question.get("layout_family", "unknown"),
+                    **dimensions,
+                }
+            )
+            for node in node_rows:
+                require(node["node_id"] not in nodes, f"duplicate global node id: {node['node_id']}")
+                nodes[node["node_id"]] = node
+
+        rejected_rows = [
+            row
+            for row in historical_rejected_rows
+            if batch_verification.get(row.get("question_id"), {}).get("state") == "safe_rejection"
+        ]
+        for row in rejected_rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            require(question_id in batch_verification, f"safe rejection without verification: {question_id}")
+            require(question_id not in safe_rows, f"duplicate safe rejection: {question_id}")
+            paper_id = row.get("paper_id")
+            require(paper_id in source_map, f"safe rejection paper missing: {question_id}")
+            safe_rows[question_id] = {**row, "batch_number": batch_number}
+            coverage_records.append(
+                {
+                    "question_id": question_id,
+                    "paper_id": paper_id,
+                    "state": "safe_rejection",
+                    "layout_family": "unresolved_safe_rejection",
+                    **paper_dimensions(paper_id),
+                }
+            )
+
+        batch_state_counts = Counter(row["state"] for row in verification_rows)
+        require(
+            len(staging_rows)
+            == batch_state_counts["resolver_verified"] + batch_state_counts["verified_agreement"],
+            f"staging conservation failed: batch {batch_number}",
+        )
+        require(len(rejected_rows) == batch_state_counts["safe_rejection"], f"safe rejection conservation failed: batch {batch_number}")
+        metric_batch = conservation_value.get("batch", conservation_value)
+        metric_denominator = metric_batch.get("membership_questions")
+        if metric_denominator is None and isinstance(metric_batch.get("state_counts"), dict):
+            metric_denominator = sum(metric_batch["state_counts"].values())
+        require(metric_denominator == len(verification_rows), f"metric denominator mismatch: batch {batch_number}")
+        metric_pass = metric_batch.get("conserved")
+        if metric_pass is None:
+            metric_pass = str(conservation_value.get("status", "")).lower() == "pass"
+        require(metric_pass, f"batch conservation not PASS: batch {batch_number}")
+
+        provider_path = active_version(batch_dir, "provider-context-retry-cost-receipt")
+        provider = read_json(provider_path)
